create_CPUModelRunner: create a CPUModelRunner instance with vllm_config and cpu device for CPU-based inference
run_load_model: run load_model to load a transformer model onto CPU with optional LoRA support
run_warming_up_model: run warming_up_model to compile and warm up the CPU model for inference
run_initialize_kv_cache: run initialize_kv_cache to set up CPU KV cache with optional EAGLE speculative decoding support
review_CPUModelRunner_speculative_decodi: review the CPU-safe speculative decoding overrides that replace CUDA stream operations with direct CPU tensor copies
